Hill fit solver using drc

Source: R/fit_solvers.R
solver_drc.Rd

The default solver of fit_drug_response_metrics: drc::drm() with drc::LL.3u() (upper asymptote fixed) or drc::LL.4() (upper asymptote fitted), within the bounds of the model. With bounds, drc optimises with stats::optim(method = "L-BFGS-B").

Usage

solver_drc(conc, x, model, control = list())

Arguments

conc

numeric vector of concentrations (not logged).

x

numeric vector of responses, the same length as conc.

model

list describing the model to fit: free parameter names, fixed values (x_0 for the 3-parameter model), and start, lower, upper over the free parameters.

control

named list of drc::drmc() settings overriding the defaults (relTol = 1e-4, errorm = FALSE, noMessage = TRUE, rmNA = TRUE). With the bounds of the model drc optimises with L-BFGS-B, which ignores relTol.

Value

list with params (named h, x_inf, x_0, ec50), rss, converged and message.

Details

A solver is any function with this signature returning the same list, and can be passed to fit_drug_response_metrics(solver = ) or through apply_fit(fit_args = list(solver = )).

Examples

model <- list(free = c("h", "x_inf", "ec50"), fixed = list(x_0 = 1),
              start = c(h = 2, x_inf = 0.4, ec50 = 0.1),
              lower = c(h = 0.1, x_inf = 0, ec50 = 1e-4),
              upper = c(h = 5, x_inf = 1, ec50 = 100))
solver_drc(c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10), c(0.95, 0.8, 0.5, 0.2, 0.1), model)
#> $params
#>          h      x_inf        x_0       ec50 
#> 0.65230324 0.05710528 1.00000000 0.07913255 
#> 
#> $rss
#> [1] 0.00018015
#> 
#> $converged
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $message
#> [1] NA
#>
